title: 2024 Topps Series 1 White #8 Brendan White Detroit Tigers Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a Brendan White Rookie Card from the 2024 Topps Series 1 set. The card features the Detroit Tigers player in a standard size on high-quality card stock. It is an original and licensed reprint with a white parallel/variety. The card is not autographed and is part of the Major League (MLB) baseball league.

The card number is #8 and it is a sports trading card with the features of being a rookie card. The card is in English language and manufactured by Topps in the United States. This item is perfect for any baseball fan or collector looking to add a quality card to their collection.
